name: The Attack!: Marzon the Silent Blade joins Lescovar in the CoA keep roof garden (#7013)
contract: Quest 434 'The Attack!' tells the player to remain in the garden until Lord Gregor Lescovar 1754 and Marzon the
Silent Blade 1755 have talked, then kill them both (RequiredNpcOrGo 1754 x1 and 1755 x1 in quest_template and in
the CoA client's quest cache). CoA moved Tyrion 7766, his Spybot 8856 and both escort paths to the keep roof garden
in rev_20260923_03_coa_stormwind.sql; Lescovar's escort now pauses at point 16 on that lawn. The player waits beside
Tyrion in the garden, so Marzon must appear within reach there (60 yd) and both must be killable once they turn
hostile, which completes both kill objectives. Lescovar is summoned at his CoA library spawn 10502 because the lane
phase hides world spawns from the Spybot.
